jobs.description:
What You Will Do

Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) is seeking a skilled professional to join our Engineering Services (ES) Division as a Reality Capture Technician within our Weapons Facilities Operations (ES-WFO) Group. This team supports the development of digital representations of facilities through terrestrial laser scanning and building information modeling. The program focuses on delivering accurate and reliable building data to support operations, planning, and engineering efforts across Laboratory facilities.

As a Reality Capture Technician at the entry level, you will support field scanning operations and structured data workflows. This includes assisting with scan setup, organizing collected data, and performing initial quality checks to ensure completeness and accuracy. You will work closely with engineers and designers while developing foundational skills in laser scanning, data processing, and digital modeling workflows.

Designer/ Drafter 1 ($49,600 - $76,700)

Assist with terrestrial LiDAR scanning operations using Leica systems
Set up tripods, scanners, targets, and field equipment
Support control point setup and scan logistics
Ingest, organize, and maintain scan data and metadata
Prepare scan data for processing in appropriate software tools
Perform initial quality checks such as coverage validation and file integrity
Follow established procedures, safety protocols, and structured workflows
Collaborate with engineers and designers to support facility documentation efforts

Designer/Drafter 2 ($54,900 - $84,300)

In addition to the responsibilities outlined at the lower level, you will:

Perform more advanced quality assurance and quality control checks, including basic error evaluation and validation of datasets.
Independently support portions of field data collection and processing workflows
Help define data organization standards and improve workflow efficiency
Participate in coordination with stakeholders to support project requirements and data deliverables
Apply working knowledge of design and drafting principles to support downstream modeling and engineering use

This position will be filled at either the Designer/Drafter 1 or 2 level, depending on the skills and experience of the selected candidate. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if the

candidate is hired at the higher level.

What You Need

Minimum Job Requirements

Experience (0-2 years) in field data collection, surveying, GIS, facilities documentation, or related technical work
Ability to learn and apply laser scanning, Revit, and building information modeling workflows
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured processes and procedures
Ability to work in field environments and comply with safety and security requirements
Basic experience with computer-based tools for data handling and organization
Foundational understanding of design/drafting or engineering concepts
Ability to work both independently on routine tasks and collaboratively in a team environment
Exposure to technical standards, structured workflows, or data management practices

Additional Job Requirements for Designer/ Drafter 2:

Working-level experience supporting technical data collection, drafting, or design workflows
Ability to apply drafting or modeling principles to support engineering-related deliverables
Experience performing quality checks and resolving basic technical/ data issues
Ability to work with minimal direction on non-routine tasks and contribute to problem solving
Familiarity with Revit tools or product/ data management systems
Working knowledge of technical standards and ability to support more complex assignments

Position requires a High School diploma or equivalent and 1 year of related experience.

Education/ Experience for Designer/Drafter 2:
Position requires a High School diploma or equivalent and 3 years of related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Desired Qualifications:

Experience with terrestrial Laser scanning system (Leica BLK360 and RTC360)
Familiarity with Autodesk ReCap, Revit, CloudCompare, or similar tools
Exposure to CAD and 3D modeling environments
Experience working in controlled or secure environments
Understanding of industry standards (such as ASME or related drafting standards)
Exposure to point cloud processing or digital twin workflows

General Summary

The Health & Environmental Program Manager will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and controlling hazards to ensure the health and well-being of LAIKA employees. This role will implement and monitor control strategies to eliminate or reduce exposure to hazards and ergonomic impacts, including managing the on-site chemical inventory and hazardous waste, support and facilitate ergonomic safety programs, and monitor hygiene-related hazards.

Job Functions

Conduct routine industrial hygiene monitoring (e.g., air quality, noise levels, chemical exposure, etc.) and maintain required documentation and reports in compliance with regulatory standards.
Maintain the chemical inventory system, ensuring accurate SDS documentation, proper labeling, and coordination with departments on chemical use reduction and substitution.
Work with ergonomic vendor to coordinate and perform ergonomic assessments of workstations and production environments, including documenting findings, making recommendations, and supporting implementation of ergonomic improvements.
Coordinate, schedule, and maintain all safety trainings and materials, working with internal teams and external vendors to ensure consistent delivery of content.
Track and manage hazardous waste storage, labeling, and disposal, including organizing pickups, maintaining manifests, and ensuring compliance with permit and SPCC plan requirements.
Support the Safety & Environmental Manager by gathering data, preparing reports, and assisting with compliance tracking related to industrial hygiene, chemical safety, and environmental programs.
Monitor studio spaces for potential ergonomic or hygiene-related risks and report findings with recommended corrective actions.
Ensure proper placement and maintenance of secondary chemical labels and safety signage in studio and production areas.
Maintain and update recordkeeping systems related to industrial hygiene monitoring, ergonomic assessments, chemical usage, and environmental compliance.
Assist with health and environment-related elements of emergency preparedness, including spill response procedures and material safety practices.

Qualifications

5+ years’ experience in production/manufacturing environment, including 2+ years are directly related to ergonomics, industrial hygiene, and environmental regulations.
Extensive knowledge of emergency response and handling hazardous materials, required.
Strong knowledge of Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) regulations on hazardous waste and the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health's (NIOSH) guidelines for workplace exposure limits, required.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as strong communication skills.
Strong computer skills and proficient in MS Office software.
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize.
Able to work both independently and collaboratively.

new_jobs.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Summary

The EHS Manager is a strategic leader responsible for cultivating a proactive, zero-harm workplace through the development, modernization, and continuous improvement of comprehensive Health, Safety, Environmental and Security programs. This position oversees all workplace safety policies, manages emergency response and investigations, acts as the primary liaison with regulatory agencies, and ensures that strict EHS compliance is built into every facility project and daily operation.

Responsibilities

Provide EHS Leadership: Deliver day-to-day health, safety, industrial hygiene, emergency response, and environmental support and guidance to facility personnel, ensuring a safe work environment consistent with company policy and federal/state regulations.
Identify and Mitigate Risks: Evaluate health and safety hazards, establish written guidelines, and implement robust control practices to protect all personnel.
Conduct Audits & Inspections: Perform routine EHS inspections and audits, and review investigation reports to ensure corrective actions are identified and implemented.
Drive Safety Culture, develop, prioritize, and deliver comprehensive EHS training and awareness programs for employees and contractors to ensure compliance, prevent injury/illness, and support site EMS certification
Manage Environmental Compliance: Oversee site environmental programs—including hazardous waste management and disposal, stormwater pollution prevention, air emission tracking, and industrial wastewater pretreatment—to ensure absolute regulatory compliance.
Oversee Security Operations, coordinate security-related activities to ensure a high level of protection for people, property, and assets.
Maintain EMS Certification, review and update the site Environmental Management System (EMS) program, driving objective and target projects to achieve and maintain ISO 14001 certification per the corporate program
Lead Incident & Case Management: Manage emergency response protocols, accident investigations, return-to-work programs, and Workers’ Compensation cases.
Track EHS Performance, compile data for reporting out Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reports on both a local leadership and corporate stakeholders.
Collect, validate, analyze, and report EHSS and sustainability metrics; identify trends and communicate results to site, regional, and corporate leadership.
Responsible for leadership of the EHSS Supervisor, and EHSS Specialist
Responsible for leading the Chem Lab operations, including supervision of the Chem Lab Supervisor.

Education And Experience

The successful EHSS Manager candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in Industrial safety, Environmental Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent education and/or relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
A minimum of 5 years of progressive EHS program management experience, preferably in the manufacturing industry.

Qualifications, Skills And Abilities

Highly self-motivated professional with a strong passion for safety and a proactive sense of urgency.
Comprehensive working knowledge of Federal, State, and local EHS regulations (e.g., OSHA, EPA).
Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with expertise in developing and delivering effective employee training.
Exceptionally organized and self-directed, with excellent communication and problem-solving skills to manage diverse responsibilities.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Compensation and Benefits:

TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available 1st of the month following date of hire.

Compensation for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience. As required by local law, TTM provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in New York, California and Colorado. For California-based roles, compensation ranges are based upon specific physical locations.
